## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Relevant Chrome/Edge or built-extension checks

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] No new data leaves the user's device, or the change and policy update clearly document it.
- [ ] Browser permissions remain minimal and user controlled.
- [ ] The extension still never submits forms automatically.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, screenshots, and diagnostics contain no credentials or confidential data.

## Model and data changes

- [ ] This pull request does not change model or dataset behavior.
- [ ] If it does, provenance, licenses, SHA-256 values, group isolation, model card, frozen benchmark, Paddle/ONNX parity, and offline browser gates are included.
- [ ] No benchmark fixture was added to training or validation data.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-visible changes are added under `Unreleased` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated when applicable.
